deadline.value: Complete your application by January 15, 2027 for funding consideration (September 2027 or January 2028 start).
deadline.quote: The application deadline is January 15, 2027 for completed applications to be considered for funding for both September 2027 and January 2028 admission.

supervisor.value: You can apply without a supervisor, but you are admitted only once a faculty member picks you from the applicant pool; contact a few faculty after applying.
supervisor.quote: Students are admitted to a supervisor if deemed admissible by the admission committee.

also.quote: When you apply you become part of a pool of potential applicants from which a potential supervisor may choose, at which point you must then be accepted by the university.

funding.value: PhD students get guaranteed minimum funding (CAD 25,000 in year 1 for international students as of February 2026), renewable for up to 4 years with satisfactory progress.
funding.quote: Funding to cover basic fees and living expenses is guaranteed for research-based MSc and PhD graduate students depending on: | Financial support for the PhD program is provided for a maximum of 4 years.

entry_route.value: A master's degree with first-class (A) standing is required for the PhD.
entry_route.quote: PhD Requirements Master's degree; and minimum "A" standing (first class)

notes: Very limited places for international applicants.
